formMetadata.purpose: Form I-130, Petition for Alien Relative, is filed by a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (the petitioner) with USCIS to establish a qualifying family relationship with a foreign national relative (the beneficiary) as the first step toward that relative obtaining an immigrant visa or adjustment of status to lawful permanent residence.
formMetadata.situations: Filed when a U.S. citizen petitions for a spouse (INA §201(b)(2)(A)(i), IR-1/CR-1), parent (INA §201(b)(2)(A)(ii), IR-5), unmarried child under 21 (INA §201(b)(2)(A)(i), IR-2/CR-2), unmarried son/daughter over 21 (INA §203(a)(1), F1), married son/daughter (INA §203(a)(3), F3), or sibling (INA §203(a)(4), F4); or when a lawful permanent resident petitions for a spouse (INA §203(a)(2)(A), F2-1), unmarried child under 21 (INA §203(a)(2)(A), F2-2), or unmarried son/daughter over 21 (INA §203(a)(2)(B), F2-4). Also covers stepchild/stepparent relationships (if marriage creating the step-relationship occurred before the child turned 18), adopted children (non-Orphan/non-Hague), and children born in or out of wedlock with specific legitimation requirements per 8 CFR §204.2.
formMetadata.use-cases: Common: (1) USC spouse petition for CR-1/IR-1 visa; (2) USC parent petitioning for adult married child (F3); (3) LPR petitioning for spouse (F2-1); (4) USC petitioning for sibling (F4); (5) USC petitioning for minor child born abroad (IR-2). Edge cases: (1) LPR who naturalized during pendency and wants automatic conversion to immediate relative category; (2) Petitioner who gained citizenship through adoption answering Part 1 Q4; (3) Widow/widower who was married to USC less than 2 years (filed within 2 years of death); (4) Stepparent-stepchild where marriage occurred before child turned 18; (5) Father petitioning for child born out of wedlock requiring proof of bona fide parent-child relationship; (6) Self-petition under VAWA (filed on Form I-360 instead, but sometimes confused with I-130).
formMetadata.filing-context: Filed with USCIS by mail to the appropriate lockbox (Dallas or Chicago depending on petitioner location) or electronically via myUSCIS. Filing fee required (currently $535 as of 2024 edition). Commonly filed concurrently with Form I-485 (Adjustment of Status) when the beneficiary is in the U.S. and a visa is immediately available; also filed with Form I-130A (Supplemental Information for Spouse Beneficiary) when petitioning for a spouse. Supporting evidence includes proof of petitioner's U.S. citizenship or LPR status (birth certificate, naturalization certificate, passport, or green card), proof of qualifying relationship (marriage certificate, birth certificates, adoption decree), passport-style photographs, and evidence of bona fide marriage for spouse petitions. Form G-28 attached if represented by attorney. Priority date is established on the date of filing. For consular processing cases, the approved I-130 is forwarded to the National Visa Center (NVC) and then to the designated U.S. Embassy/Consulate.
formMetadata.parties-involved: Petitioner: The U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident who files the I-130 to establish a qualifying family relationship with the beneficiary. Beneficiary: The foreign national relative for whom the petition is filed, who will ultimately seek an immigrant visa or adjustment of status based on the approved petition. Interpreter: A person who translates every question and instruction on the petition for the petitioner if the petitioner cannot read and understand English. Preparer: A person (attorney, accredited representative, or other individual) who physically prepares the petition on behalf of the petitioner based on information the petitioner provided or authorized. Attorney/Accredited Representative: A licensed attorney or DOJ-accredited representative who may represent the petitioner; identified in the G-28 block at the top of the form.

fields.description: Part 2, Item Number 3: U.S. Social Security Number (if any). The petitioner's 9-digit SSN issued by the Social Security Administration.
fields.notes: Format: 9 digits, typically entered as NNN-NN-NNNN or NNNNNNNNN. Source: Social Security card or SSA records. If the petitioner does not have an SSN, leave blank. Do not enter 'None' or 'N/A'. This helps USCIS verify identity and conduct background checks. Common mistake: entering an ITIN instead of SSN.

fields.description: Checkbox in the attorney/representative block: 'Select this box if Form G-28 is attached.' Indicates that a completed Form G-28, Notice of Entry of Appearance as Attorney or Accredited Representative, accompanies this petition.
fields.notes: Check only if a Form G-28 is being submitted with this petition. If checked, the attorney/accredited representative information fields in this block should also be completed. If the petitioner is self-represented, leave unchecked.

fields.description: Volag Number (if any). The voluntary agency number assigned to a recognized organization providing legal representation, typically in refugee/asylee contexts.
fields.notes: Applies only if the preparer is affiliated with a recognized Voluntary Agency (VOLAG). Most I-130 filings will leave this blank. Entered in the attorney/accredited representative block at top of page 1.

fields.description: Attorney State Bar Number (if applicable). The state bar license number of the attorney representing the petitioner.
fields.notes: Required if an attorney is representing the petitioner. Enter the bar number from the state where the attorney is admitted. Leave blank if preparer is an accredited representative or if petitioner is self-represented.

fields.description: Attorney or Accredited Representative USCIS Online Account Number (if any). The USCIS online account number belonging to the attorney or accredited representative.
fields.notes: This is the representative's own USCIS online account number, not the petitioner's. 12-digit number. Leave blank if not applicable or unknown.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 1 checkbox: 'Spouse'. Select if you are filing this petition for your spouse. Complete question: 'I am filing this petition for my (Select only one box): Spouse'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Parent, Brother/Sister, and Child checkboxes. Selecting Spouse means the beneficiary is the petitioner's husband or wife. If selected, petitioner must also complete spouse-specific sections including last address lived together (Part 4, Items 59-60) and Form I-130A. Determines visa category: IR-1/CR-1 if petitioner is USC; F2-1 if petitioner is LPR.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 1 checkbox: 'Brother/Sister'. Select if you are filing this petition for your brother or sister. Complete question: 'I am filing this petition for my (Select only one box): Brother/Sister'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Spouse, Parent, and Child. Only U.S. citizens may petition for siblings (F4 category). If selected, must answer Item 3 about whether related by adoption. LPRs cannot petition for siblings. Petitioner must be at least 21 years old.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 1 checkbox: 'Parent'. Select if you are filing this petition for your parent. Complete question: 'I am filing this petition for my (Select only one box): Parent'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Spouse, Brother/Sister, and Child. Only U.S. citizens who are at least 21 years old may petition for parents (IR-5 category). LPRs cannot petition for parents. If selected, must also complete Item 2 to describe the parent-child relationship.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 1 checkbox: 'Child'. Select if you are filing this petition for your child. Complete question: 'I am filing this petition for my (Select only one box): Child'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Spouse, Parent, and Brother/Sister. If selected, must also complete Item 2 to describe the child relationship type. Visa category depends on child's age, marital status, and petitioner's status: IR-2/CR-2 (USC petitioner, unmarried child under 21), F1 (USC, unmarried son/daughter over 21), F3 (USC, married son/daughter), F2-2 (LPR, unmarried child under 21), F2-4 (LPR, unmarried son/daughter over 21).

fields.description: Part 1, Item 2 checkbox: 'Child was born to parents who were married to each other at the time of the child's birth'. Describes the nature of the parent-child relationship when petitioning for a child or parent.
fields.notes: Select only one Item 2 checkbox. Only applicable if Item 1 is 'Child' or 'Parent'. Legitimate (in-wedlock) children have the most straightforward evidentiary requirements. Source: child's birth certificate showing married parents.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 2 checkbox: 'Child was adopted (not an Orphan or Hague Convention adoptee)'. Indicates the child was legally adopted but not under the Orphan or Hague Convention process.
fields.notes: Select only one Item 2 checkbox. Adoption must have been finalized before the child turned 16 (or 18 if sibling exception applies under INA §101(b)(1)(E)). Child must have been in legal custody of and resided with the adopting parent(s) for at least 2 years. Orphan and Hague adoptions use Forms I-600/I-800 instead.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 2 checkbox: 'Stepchild/Stepparent'. Indicates the relationship is a stepchild or stepparent relationship.
fields.notes: Select only one Item 2 checkbox. The marriage creating the step-relationship must have occurred before the child turned 18. Applies to both petitioning for a stepchild and petitioning for a stepparent. Evidence required: marriage certificate and child's birth certificate.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 2 checkbox: 'Child was born to parents who were not married to each other at the time of the child's birth'. Indicates an out-of-wedlock birth.
fields.notes: Select only one Item 2 checkbox. If the petitioner is the father, must show bona fide parent-child relationship existed while the child was unmarried and under 21 (or the child was legitimated under applicable law). If petitioner is the mother, relationship is generally established by birth certificate. See INA §101(b)(1)(D) and 8 CFR §204.2(d)(2).

fields.description: Part 1, Item 3 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'If the beneficiary is your brother/sister, are you related by adoption?' Selecting Yes means the sibling relationship exists through adoption.
fields.notes: Only applicable when Item 1 'Brother/Sister' is selected. If Yes, specific adoption requirements under INA §101(b)(1) must be met. The adoption must have occurred before both the petitioner and beneficiary turned 16. This is a critical eligibility question.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 4 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Did you gain lawful permanent resident status or citizenship through adoption?' Selecting No means the petitioner did not obtain immigration status through adoption.
fields.notes: If No is selected, no further implications for sibling or parent petitions based on adoption status. Most petitioners will select No.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 4 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Did you gain lawful permanent resident status or citizenship through adoption?' Selecting Yes means the petitioner obtained immigration status through adoption.
fields.notes: If Yes, the petitioner who gained status through adoption cannot petition for natural parents or natural siblings unless exceptional conditions are met. Under INA §101(b)(1)(E) and (F), an adopted child cannot confer immigration benefits on natural parents or siblings. Critical for determining eligibility.

fields.description: Part 1, Item 3 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'If the beneficiary is your brother/sister, are you related by adoption?' Selecting No means the sibling relationship is biological or by step-relationship, not adoption.
fields.notes: Only applicable when Item 1 'Brother/Sister' is selected. If No, the sibling relationship is biological or through a step-relationship.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 4.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the petitioner. The petitioner's legal surname as it appears on official identity documents.
fields.notes: Must match the name on the petitioner's proof of U.S. citizenship or LPR status (birth certificate, naturalization certificate, passport, or green card). Use all capital letters for consistency. If name has changed, the current legal name should be entered here and former names in Item 5.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 4.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the petitioner. The petitioner's legal first name.
fields.notes: Must match the name on citizenship/LPR documentation. Do not use nicknames. If the petitioner has a single name with no first/last distinction, enter it in the Family Name field and write 'FNU' (First Name Unknown) here per USCIS guidance.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 4.c.: Middle Name of the petitioner. The petitioner's legal middle name.
fields.notes: Leave blank if the petitioner has no middle name. Do not enter 'N/A' or 'None'. Enter full middle name, not just an initial, if known.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 1: Alien Registration Number (A-Number) (if any). The petitioner's 7-9 digit A-Number assigned by USCIS/legacy INS.
fields.notes: Format: up to 9 digits, preceded by 'A-' which is pre-printed. Petitioners who are naturalized citizens or LPRs will have an A-Number from their green card or naturalization certificate. U.S.-born citizens typically will not have one. Leave blank if none. Do not confuse with the beneficiary's A-Number in Part 4.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 2: USCIS Online Account Number (if any). The petitioner's 12-digit USCIS online account number from their myUSCIS account.
fields.notes: 12-digit number. Leave blank if the petitioner does not have a USCIS online account. This is different from the A-Number. Created when a user registers on myUSCIS.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 8: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy). The petitioner's date of birth.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: birth certificate, passport, or naturalization certificate. Must be consistent across all immigration forms. Petitioner's age is relevant for certain petition types (must be 21+ to petition for parents or siblings).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 9 checkbox: 'Male'. Select if the petitioner's sex is male.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Female. Select based on current legal gender. Should match the petitioner's identity documents.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 9 checkbox: 'Female'. Select if the petitioner's sex is female.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Male. Select based on current legal gender.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 7: Country of Birth. The country where the petitioner was born.
fields.notes: Use current country name even if the country's name has changed since birth (e.g., use 'Russia' not 'USSR'). Source: birth certificate or passport. For U.S.-born citizens, enter 'United States'.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 11 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Is your current mailing address the same as your physical address?' Selecting Yes means the mailing address in Items 10.a.-10.i. is also the petitioner's physical residence.
fields.notes: If Yes, skip Items 12-13 (Physical Address 1). If No, must provide physical address in Items 12.a.-13.b. and address history.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 11 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Is your current mailing address the same as your physical address?' Selecting No means the mailing address differs from the physical address.
fields.notes: If No, must complete Items 12.a.-13.b. for Physical Address 1. Common when using a P.O. Box or c/o address for mail but living elsewhere.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.a.: Street Number and Name for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Include house/building number and full street name. Do not include apartment/suite/floor information here; use Item 10.b. for that. USPS-standard formatting preferred.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the petitioner's mailing address. Select if the unit designation is an apartment.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr. checkboxes. Select one if applicable, then enter the number in the adjacent field.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' (Suite) for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr. checkboxes.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' (Floor) for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste. checkboxes.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Enter the unit number/letter corresponding to the selected unit type (Apt/Ste/Flr). Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.c.: City or Town for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Must match USPS records for U.S. addresses. For foreign addresses, use the local city/town name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.g.: Province for the petitioner's mailing address. Used for foreign addresses.
fields.notes: Only complete if the address is outside the United States. Leave blank for U.S. addresses. Corresponds to province, region, or equivalent administrative division.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.i.: Postal Code for the petitioner's mailing address. Used for foreign addresses.
fields.notes: Only complete for foreign addresses. For U.S. addresses, use the ZIP Code field instead. Format varies by country.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.f.: ZIP Code for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP code for U.S. addresses. Leave blank for foreign addresses. Can be verified via USPS ZIP Code Lookup.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.e.: State for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Use standard 2-letter state abbreviation for U.S. addresses. Dropdown or text field. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.h.: Country for the petitioner's mailing address.
fields.notes: Use full country name. For U.S. addresses, enter 'United States'. Required for all addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 10.d.: In Care Of Name for the petitioner's mailing address. The name of a person or entity receiving mail on behalf of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Optional. Used when mail should be directed to another person at the address (e.g., 'c/o John Smith'). Enter only the name, not 'c/o' prefix. Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.a.: Street Number and Name for Physical Address 2. Part of the petitioner's address history for the last five years.
fields.notes: This is the second previous physical address. Required if the petitioner has lived at more than one previous address in the last 5 years. Complete with dates in Items 15.a.-15.b.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Enter the unit number corresponding to the selected unit type. Leave blank if not applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.c.: City or Town for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Enter the city or town of the petitioner's second previous physical address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.d.: State for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.e.: ZIP Code for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: 5- or 9-digit ZIP code for U.S. addresses. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.f.: Province for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only. Leave blank for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.g.: Country for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: Full country name. Required for all addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 14.h.: Postal Code for Physical Address 2.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only. Leave blank for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 13.a.: Date From (mm/dd/yyyy) for Physical Address 1. The date the petitioner began residing at this physical address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. This is for the first previous physical address (Items 12.a.-12.h.). Combined with Date To (13.b.) to show duration of residence.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 15.a.: Date From (mm/dd/yyyy) for Physical Address 2. The date the petitioner began residing at the second previous address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Address history must cover the last 5 years.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 15.b.: Date To (mm/dd/yyyy) for Physical Address 2. The date the petitioner stopped residing at the second previous address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Should connect chronologically with other address date ranges. If additional addresses are needed, use Part 9.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.a.: Street Number and Name for Physical Address 1. The petitioner's current or most recent physical address if different from the mailing address.
fields.notes: Required if Item 11 is 'No'. This is the primary physical address section. If mailing and physical address are the same, this section may be skipped.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Enter the unit number corresponding to the selected unit type.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.c.: City or Town for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Enter the city or town of the petitioner's physical address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.d.: State for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.e.: ZIP Code for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: 5- or 9-digit ZIP code. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.f.: Province for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.g.: Country for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: Full country name. Required.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 12.h.: Postal Code for Physical Address 1.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 6: City/Town/Village of Birth. The petitioner's place of birth at the city/town level.
fields.notes: Source: birth certificate or passport. Enter the city, town, or village name. Should match other immigration documents.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 5.a.: Family Name (Last Name) under 'Other Names Used (if any)'. Any other surname the petitioner has ever used, including aliases, maiden name, and nicknames.
fields.notes: Enter previous or alternate surnames. Most commonly the maiden name for married petitioners. If no other names used, leave blank. Do not enter 'N/A' or 'None'. Multiple other names may require Part 9.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 5.b.: Given Name (First Name) under 'Other Names Used (if any)'. Any other first name the petitioner has ever used.
fields.notes: Include nicknames, aliases, or prior legal first names. Leave blank if no other given names used.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 5.c.: Middle Name under 'Other Names Used (if any)'. Any other middle name the petitioner has ever used.
fields.notes: Leave blank if no other middle names used.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 16: How many times have you been married? Total number of marriages the petitioner has had, including the current marriage.
fields.notes: Enter a numeric value. Minimum is 0 (if never married, though marital status should then be 'Single, Never Married'). Includes all legal marriages, including those ending in divorce, annulment, or death of spouse. Common mistake: forgetting to count the current marriage.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Widowed'. Select if the petitioner's current marital status is widowed.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. A widowed petitioner may still file for certain relatives. Supporting evidence: death certificate of deceased spouse.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Annulled'. Select if the petitioner's most recent marriage was annulled.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. Annulment decree required as evidence.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Separated'. Select if the petitioner is legally separated.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. Legal separation does not terminate a marriage; petitioner is still considered married for immigration purposes in most jurisdictions.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Single, Never Married'. Select if the petitioner has never been married.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. If selected, Item 16 should be 0 and no spouse information is needed.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Married'. Select if the petitioner is currently legally married.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. If selected, must complete Item 18 (date of marriage), Item 19 (place of marriage), and spouse information in Items 20-21.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 17 checkbox: 'Divorced'. Select if the petitioner is currently divorced.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status checkboxes. Divorce decree required as evidence. If filing for a spouse, this should not be selected (would indicate a mismatch).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 13.b.: Date To (mm/dd/yyyy) for Physical Address 1. The date the petitioner stopped residing at this physical address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. If this is the current physical address, enter 'PRESENT' or leave blank depending on form instructions. Should be filled if the petitioner has moved and this is a previous address.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 20.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Spouse 1. The surname of the petitioner's current spouse (if married) or first prior spouse.
fields.notes: Enter current spouse first, then prior spouses. Source: marriage certificate. Must match legal name at time of marriage or current legal name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 20.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Spouse 1.
fields.notes: First name of the petitioner's current/first spouse.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 20.c.: Middle Name of Spouse 1.
fields.notes: Leave blank if the spouse has no middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 23: Date Marriage Ended (mm/dd/yyyy) for Spouse 2. The date the petitioner's marriage to Spouse 2 legally ended.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: divorce decree, annulment order, or death certificate. Required if there was a second marriage that has ended.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 22.c.: Middle Name of Spouse 2.
fields.notes: Leave blank if Spouse 2 has no middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 22.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Spouse 2.
fields.notes: First name of the petitioner's second spouse.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 22.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Spouse 2.
fields.notes: Surname of the petitioner's second spouse. Enter the name as it was at the time of the marriage.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 21: Date Marriage Ended (mm/dd/yyyy) for Spouse 1. The date the petitioner's marriage to Spouse 1 legally ended.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Required if the first marriage has ended. Leave blank if Spouse 1 is the current spouse and the marriage has not ended.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 18: Date of Current Marriage (if currently married) (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the petitioner's current marriage took place.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: marriage certificate. Only complete if marital status is 'Married'. Critical for spouse petitions; the marriage date establishes when the relationship began for immigration purposes.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Parent 1. The full legal surname of the petitioner's first parent.
fields.notes: Enter the parent's current legal name or name at time of the petitioner's birth. Source: petitioner's birth certificate. Parent 1 is typically the mother but either parent may be listed first.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Parent 1.
fields.notes: First name of the petitioner's Parent 1.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 24.c.: Middle Name of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Leave blank if Parent 1 has no middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 25: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: Parent's birth certificate or other official document.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 28: City/Town/Village of Residence of Parent 1. Where Parent 1 currently resides.
fields.notes: Enter current residence city/town. If deceased, may enter 'Deceased' or leave blank per USCIS guidance.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 29: Country of Residence of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Current country where Parent 1 lives. If deceased, may enter 'N/A' or leave blank.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 27: Country of Birth of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Use current country name. Source: Parent's birth certificate or the petitioner's birth certificate listing parent's birthplace.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 30.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Parent 2.
fields.notes: First name of the petitioner's second parent.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 30.c.: Middle Name of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Leave blank if Parent 2 has no middle name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 30.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Surname of the petitioner's second parent. Source: petitioner's birth certificate.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 31: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 34: City/Town/Village of Residence of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Current residence city/town of Parent 2. If deceased, may enter 'Deceased'.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 35: Country of Residence of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Current country where Parent 2 lives.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 33: Country of Birth of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Use current country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 36 checkbox: 'U.S. Citizen'. Complete question: 'I am a (Select only one box): U.S. Citizen'. Indicates the petitioner is a United States citizen.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Lawful Permanent Resident'. Determines which visa categories are available and which relatives can be petitioned for. If selected, must complete Item 37 (how citizenship was acquired). Evidence: birth certificate (if born in U.S.), naturalization certificate, Certificate of Citizenship, or U.S. passport.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 36 checkbox: 'Lawful Permanent Resident'. Complete question: 'I am a (Select only one box): Lawful Permanent Resident'. Indicates the petitioner is a lawful permanent resident (green card holder).
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'U.S. Citizen'. LPRs can only petition for spouses and unmarried children (F2 categories). Cannot petition for parents, siblings, or married children. If selected, must complete Items 40-41 (admission information).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 37 checkbox: 'Birth in the United States'. Under 'My citizenship was acquired through (Select only one box)'. Indicates the petitioner is a U.S. citizen by birth in the United States.
fields.notes: Only applicable if Item 36 is 'U.S. Citizen'. Mutually exclusive with Naturalization and Parents checkboxes. Evidence: U.S. birth certificate or Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 37 checkbox: 'Naturalization'. Under 'My citizenship was acquired through (Select only one box)'. Indicates the petitioner became a U.S. citizen through naturalization.
fields.notes: Only applicable if Item 36 is 'U.S. Citizen'. Mutually exclusive. If selected and Item 38 is Yes, must provide Certificate of Naturalization details in Items 39.a.-39.c.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 37 checkbox: 'Parents'. Under 'My citizenship was acquired through (Select only one box)'. Indicates the petitioner derived or acquired U.S. citizenship through their parents.
fields.notes: Only applicable if Item 36 is 'U.S. Citizen'. Mutually exclusive. Applies to those who derived citizenship under INA §320 or §322 or acquired it at birth abroad under INA §301 or §309. If selected, may have Certificate of Citizenship.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 39.a.: Certificate Number. The number on the petitioner's Certificate of Naturalization (Form N-550/N-570) or Certificate of Citizenship (Form N-560/N-561).
fields.notes: Only required if Item 38 is 'Yes'. Located on the face of the certificate. Alphanumeric, typically 7-8 characters.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 38 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Have you obtained a Certificate of Naturalization or a Certificate of Citizenship?' Selecting Yes means the petitioner has obtained such a certificate.
fields.notes: Only applicable if petitioner selected U.S. Citizen through Naturalization or Parents. If Yes, must complete Items 39.a.-39.c. with certificate details.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 38 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Have you obtained a Certificate of Naturalization or a Certificate of Citizenship?' Selecting No means the petitioner has not obtained such a certificate.
fields.notes: If No, skip Items 39.a.-39.c. The petitioner may prove citizenship through other means (e.g., U.S. passport, birth certificate).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 39.c.: Date of Issuance (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the Certificate of Naturalization or Citizenship was issued.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Found on the face of the certificate.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 39.b.: Place of Issuance. The location (city/office) where the Certificate of Naturalization or Citizenship was issued.
fields.notes: Typically the USCIS office or court where the naturalization ceremony took place. Found on the certificate.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 26 checkbox: 'Male'. Sex of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Female. Identifies the sex of the petitioner's Parent 1.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 26 checkbox: 'Female'. Sex of Parent 1.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Male.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 32 checkbox: 'Male'. Sex of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Female.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 32 checkbox: 'Female'. Sex of Parent 2.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Male.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 19.a.: City or Town of the petitioner's current marriage. Place where the current marriage ceremony occurred.
fields.notes: Only complete if currently married (Item 17 = 'Married'). Source: marriage certificate.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 19.b.: State of the petitioner's current marriage. U.S. state where the marriage took place.
fields.notes: Leave blank if married outside the U.S. 2-letter abbreviation.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 19.c.: Province of the petitioner's current marriage. For marriages outside the U.S.
fields.notes: Only for foreign marriages. Leave blank if married in the U.S.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 19.d.: Country of the petitioner's current marriage.
fields.notes: Full country name. Enter 'United States' if married in the U.S.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 40.a.: Class of Admission. The immigration classification under which the petitioner was admitted as a lawful permanent resident.
fields.notes: Only for LPR petitioners. Found on the green card (Form I-551) or I-94. Examples: IR1, CR1, F21, EB2, DV1, RE (returning resident), etc. Must match official records.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 40.b.: Date of Admission (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the petitioner was admitted as a lawful permanent resident.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Found on the green card. For adjustment of status cases, this is the date the I-485 was approved. Only for LPR petitioners.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 40.c.: City or Town of admission. The city where the petitioner was admitted as an LPR.
fields.notes: For entries at a port of entry, enter that city. For adjustment of status, enter the city of the USCIS office. Only for LPR petitioners.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 41 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Did you gain lawful permanent resident status through marriage to a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident?' Selecting No means LPR status was not gained through marriage.
fields.notes: Only for LPR petitioners. If the petitioner gained LPR status through marriage and is now petitioning for a new spouse, USCIS applies heightened scrutiny under INA §204(a)(2)(A) (5-year bar with exceptions).

fields.description: Part 2, Item 41 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Did you gain lawful permanent resident status through marriage to a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident?' Selecting Yes triggers special scrutiny.
fields.notes: If Yes, INA §204(a)(2)(A) applies: the LPR petitioner cannot file a spouse/child petition until 5 years after gaining LPR status, unless they can demonstrate by clear and convincing evidence that the prior marriage was not entered into to evade immigration law, or the prior marriage was terminated by death.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.a.: Street Number and Name of the petitioner's current or most recent employer address.
fields.notes: Part of the Employment History section. Provide the employer's physical address. If self-employed, provide your business address.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr. Rarely applicable for employer addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for employer address.
fields.notes: Enter the suite/floor number of the employer's address.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.c.: City or Town for employer address.
fields.notes: City where the employer is located.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.f.: Province for employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign employer addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.g.: Postal Code for employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign employer addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.e.: ZIP Code for employer address.
fields.notes: For U.S. employer addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.d.: State for employer address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 43.h.: Country for employer address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 42: Name of Employer/Company. The name of the petitioner's current or most recent employer.
fields.notes: If currently unemployed, type or print 'Unemployed'. If self-employed, enter 'Self-employed' or business name. This is the first entry in the 5-year employment history.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.a.: Street Number and Name for the petitioner's second employer address.
fields.notes: Address of the second employer in the 5-year employment history.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for second employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for second employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for second employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for second employer address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.c.: City or Town for second employer address.
fields.notes: City of second employer.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.f.: Province for second employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.g.: Postal Code for second employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.e.: ZIP Code for second employer address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.d.: State for second employer address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 47.h.: Country for second employer address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 48: Your Occupation at the second employer.
fields.notes: Brief description of the petitioner's job title or role at the second employer.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 49.a.: Date From (mm/dd/yyyy) for second employer.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Start date of employment at the second employer.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 49.b.: Date To (mm/dd/yyyy) for second employer.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. End date. If still employed at this time, leave as 'Present' or as applicable.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 1 checkbox: 'Hispanic or Latino'. Ethnicity of the petitioner. Complete question: 'Ethnicity (Select only one box): Hispanic or Latino'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Not Hispanic or Latino'. Part 3 collects biographic information about the petitioner. This is for demographic/statistical purposes.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 1 checkbox: 'Not Hispanic or Latino'. Ethnicity of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'Hispanic or Latino'.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2 checkbox: 'Black or African American'. Race of the petitioner. Complete question: 'Race (Select all applicable boxes)'.
fields.notes: Multiple race selections allowed. Self-identified.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2 checkbox: 'American Indian or Alaska Native'. Race of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Multiple selections allowed.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2 checkbox: 'White'. Race of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Multiple selections allowed.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2 checkbox: 'Asian'. Race of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Multiple selections allowed.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 2 checkbox: 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander'. Race of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Multiple selections allowed.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 3: Height - Feet. The petitioner's height in feet.
fields.notes: Numeric value, whole number. Typically 4-6 for adults. Used for biographic identification.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 3: Height - Inches. The petitioner's height in remaining inches.
fields.notes: Numeric value 0-11. Combined with Feet to give full height.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4: Weight - Pounds (first digit or hundreds). The petitioner's weight in pounds.
fields.notes: This appears to be a multi-field weight entry. First digit field (hundreds place). Enter the hundreds digit of weight (e.g., '1' for 185 lbs). If weight is under 100, may leave blank or enter 0.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4: Weight - Pounds (second digit or tens). The petitioner's weight tens digit.
fields.notes: Tens digit of weight (e.g., '8' for 185 lbs).

fields.description: Part 3, Item 4: Weight - Pounds (third digit or ones). The petitioner's weight ones digit.
fields.notes: Ones digit of weight (e.g., '5' for 185 lbs).

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 2, Item 46: Name of Employer/Company. The name of the petitioner's second employer in the 5-year history.
fields.notes: Enter the second employer's name. If the petitioner had only one employer in 5 years, this may be blank.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 44: Your Occupation at the current/most recent employer.
fields.notes: Brief job title or occupational description. Example: 'Software Engineer', 'Teacher', 'Homemaker'.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 45.a.: Date From (mm/dd/yyyy) for current/most recent employer.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Start date of current employment.

fields.description: Part 2, Employer 1, Item 45.b.: Date To (mm/dd/yyyy) for current/most recent employer.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. If currently employed, enter 'Present' or current date.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Black'. Eye Color of the petitioner. Complete question: 'Eye Color (Select only one box)'.
fields.notes: Select only one eye color. Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Blue'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other eye color options.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Brown'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Gray'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Green'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Hazel'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Maroon'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Pink'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 5 checkbox: 'Unknown/Other'. Eye Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive. Select if eye color does not match any listed option.

fields.description: Part 2, Item 40.d.: State of admission. The U.S. state where the petitioner was admitted as an LPR.
fields.notes: Only for LPR petitioners. 2-letter abbreviation. For port of entry admissions, the state of the port. For AOS, the state of the USCIS office.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 1: Alien Registration Number (A-Number) (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Format: up to 9 digits preceded by 'A-'. The beneficiary may have an A-Number from prior immigration proceedings or applications. Leave blank if the beneficiary has never had one. Source: prior immigration documents, EAD, or previous petition receipts.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 2: USCIS Online Account Number (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: 12-digit number from the beneficiary's myUSCIS account. Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 4.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the beneficiary. The beneficiary's current legal surname.
fields.notes: Must match the name on the beneficiary's passport or travel document. Critical for visa issuance and entry. Use all capital letters for consistency.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 4.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Must match the beneficiary's passport. Do not use nicknames.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 4.c.: Middle Name of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none. Must match passport.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5.a.: Family Name (Last Name) under 'Other Names Used (if any)' for the beneficiary. Any other surname the beneficiary has ever used.
fields.notes: Includes maiden name, aliases, nicknames, and prior legal names. Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5.b.: Given Name (First Name) under 'Other Names Used' for the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Leave blank if no other given names used.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 5.c.: Middle Name under 'Other Names Used' for the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Leave blank if no other middle names used.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 6: City/Town/Village of Birth of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Source: beneficiary's birth certificate or passport. Use the city/town name as it appears in official documents.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 7: Country of Birth of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Use current country name. This determines the beneficiary's chargeability for visa quota purposes unless cross-chargeability applies.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.g.: Province for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: For addresses outside the U.S. Leave blank for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.h.: Postal Code for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses. Leave blank for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.f.: Country for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Full country name. If the beneficiary is living abroad, enter that country. If in the U.S., enter 'United States'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.a.: Street Number and Name for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address. The address in the United States where the beneficiary intends to live.
fields.notes: If the same as Item 11 address, type 'SAME'. This is where USCIS correspondence will be directed after admission. Required for all beneficiaries.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.c.: City or Town for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: U.S. city where beneficiary intends to reside.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.e.: ZIP Code for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: 5- or 9-digit U.S. ZIP code.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 12.d.: State for the beneficiary's intended U.S. address.
fields.notes: 2-letter state abbreviation.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.e.: Postal Code for the beneficiary's address outside the United States.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses. If same as Item 11, enter 'SAME' in Item 13.a.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.a.: Street Number and Name for the beneficiary's address outside the United States.
fields.notes: If the same as Item 11, type or print 'SAME'. This captures the beneficiary's foreign mailing address if different from the physical address.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.c.: City or Town for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Enter the city/town for the beneficiary's overseas address.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.f.: Country for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 13.d.: Province for the beneficiary's foreign address.
fields.notes: Province or equivalent administrative division.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.a.: Street Number and Name for the beneficiary's physical address where the beneficiary currently lives.
fields.notes: If the beneficiary lives outside the U.S. in a home without a street number or name, leave Items 11.a. and 11.b. blank per form instructions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Enter the unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.c.: City or Town for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: Enter the city or town where the beneficiary currently resides.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.e.: ZIP Code for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses only. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 11.d.: State for the beneficiary's physical address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation. For U.S. addresses only.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 8: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: beneficiary's birth certificate or passport. Critical for determining visa classification (child vs. son/daughter based on age 21 cutoff under CSPA).

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9 checkbox: 'Male'. Sex of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Female.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 9 checkbox: 'Female'. Sex of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Male.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Bald (No hair)'. Hair Color of the petitioner. Complete question: 'Hair Color (Select only one box)'.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other hair color options. Part 3 biographic information continued.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Black'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Blond'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Brown'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Gray'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Red'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Sandy'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'White'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 3, Item 6 checkbox: 'Unknown/Other'. Hair Color of the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive. Select if hair color does not match any listed option.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 10 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Has anyone else ever filed a petition for the beneficiary?' Selecting Yes means a prior I-130 or other immigrant petition has been filed for this beneficiary.
fields.notes: If Yes, USCIS may review prior petition history. Important for detecting fraud patterns. Does not by itself affect eligibility.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 10 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Has anyone else ever filed a petition for the beneficiary?'
fields.notes: Select if no one else has ever filed an immigrant petition for this beneficiary.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 10 checkbox: 'Unknown'. Complete question: 'Has anyone else ever filed a petition for the beneficiary?' Select only if you do not know, and the beneficiary also does not know, if anyone else has ever filed a petition for the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Use sparingly. The form instructs: 'Select Unknown only if you do not know, and the beneficiary also does not know, if anyone else has ever filed a petition for the beneficiary.'

fields.description: Part 4, Item 14: Daytime Telephone Number (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Include country code for international numbers. Leave blank if the beneficiary has no phone. Format: flexible, but typically include area/country code.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 3: U.S. Social Security Number (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Format: 9 digits. Most beneficiaries abroad will not have an SSN. Only enter if the beneficiary has been issued one (e.g., from prior U.S. employment authorization). Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 20.c.: Province of the beneficiary's current marriage place.
fields.notes: For marriages outside the U.S. Leave blank if married in the U.S.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 17: How many times has the beneficiary been married? Total number of the beneficiary's marriages.
fields.notes: Numeric value including current marriage. Important for spouse petitions to verify prior marriages were legally terminated.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Single, Never Married'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with other marital status options. If selected, Item 17 should be 0.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Married'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive. If filing as spouse, this should be selected. Must provide marriage date and spouse details.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Divorced'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive. If the beneficiary is divorced, cannot be petitioned as a spouse.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Widowed'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Separated'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive. Legal separation does not terminate a marriage.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 18 checkbox: 'Annulled'. Current marital status of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 15: Mobile Telephone Number (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Include country code for international numbers. Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 16: Email Address (if any) of the beneficiary.
fields.notes: Leave blank if the beneficiary has no email. Used for NVC communications during consular processing.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 19: Date of Current Marriage (if currently married) (mm/dd/yyyy). Date of the beneficiary's current marriage.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: marriage certificate. Only complete if the beneficiary is currently married.

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 1, Item 21.a.: Family Name (Last Name). Current spouse listed first, then prior spouses.
fields.notes: Name of the beneficiary's current or first spouse.

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 1, Item 21.b.: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of the beneficiary's current/first spouse.

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 1, Item 21.c.: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 2, Item 23.a.: Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Name of the beneficiary's second spouse (prior spouse).

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 2, Item 23.b.: Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: First name of beneficiary's second spouse.

fields.description: Part 4, Beneficiary's Spouse 2, Item 23.c.: Middle Name.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 22: Date Marriage Ended (mm/dd/yyyy) for Beneficiary's Spouse 1. The date the beneficiary's first marriage ended.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Leave blank if this is the current spouse and marriage has not ended.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 24: Date Marriage Ended (mm/dd/yyyy) for Beneficiary's Spouse 2. The date the beneficiary's second marriage ended.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Required if the second marriage has ended.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 26: Relationship. The relationship of Person 1 to the beneficiary (e.g., 'Spouse', 'Son', 'Daughter').
fields.notes: Part of 'Information About Beneficiary's Family'. List the beneficiary's spouse and children. Enter the specific relationship.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 25.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Person 1 in the beneficiary's family.
fields.notes: Typically the beneficiary's spouse or first child.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 25.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Person 1.
fields.notes: First name of the family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 25.c.: Middle Name of Person 1.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 27: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Person 1.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 1, Item 28: Country of Birth of Person 1.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 30: Relationship of Person 2 to the beneficiary.
fields.notes: E.g., 'Son', 'Daughter', 'Spouse'.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 31: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Person 2.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 32: Country of Birth of Person 2.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 29.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Person 2.
fields.notes: Surname of the second family member listed.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 29.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Person 2.
fields.notes: First name of the second family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 2, Item 29.c.: Middle Name of Person 2.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 33.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Person 3.
fields.notes: First name of the third family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 33.c.: Middle Name of Person 3.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 33.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Person 3.
fields.notes: Surname of the third family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 36: Country of Birth of Person 3.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 35: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Person 3.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 3, Item 34: Relationship of Person 3 to the beneficiary.
fields.notes: E.g., 'Son', 'Daughter'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 20.a.: City or Town of the beneficiary's current marriage place.
fields.notes: Where the beneficiary's current marriage took place. Source: marriage certificate.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 20.b.: State of the beneficiary's current marriage place.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation. Leave blank if married outside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 20.d.: Country of the beneficiary's current marriage place.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 37.c.: Middle Name of Person 4 in the beneficiary's family.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 37.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Person 4.
fields.notes: First name of the fourth family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 37.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Person 4.
fields.notes: Surname of the fourth family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 40: Country of Birth of Person 4.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 39: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Person 4.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 4, Item 38: Relationship of Person 4 to the beneficiary.
fields.notes: E.g., 'Son', 'Daughter'.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 41.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of Person 5 in the beneficiary's family.
fields.notes: Surname of the fifth family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 41.b.: Given Name (First Name) of Person 5.
fields.notes: First name of the fifth family member.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 41.c.: Middle Name of Person 5.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 42: Relationship of Person 5 to the beneficiary.
fields.notes: E.g., 'Son', 'Daughter'.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 44: Country of Birth of Person 5.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Person 5, Item 43: Date of Birth (mm/dd/yyyy) of Person 5.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 45 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Was the beneficiary EVER in the United States?' Selecting Yes means the beneficiary has been in the U.S. at some point.
fields.notes: If Yes, must complete Items 46.a.-46.d. with entry information. Important for determining admissibility and whether adjustment of status is possible.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 45 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Was the beneficiary EVER in the United States?' Selecting No means the beneficiary has never been in the U.S.
fields.notes: If No, skip Items 46.a.-46.d. Beneficiary will process through consular processing abroad.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 46.d.: Date authorized stay expired, or will expire, as shown on Form I-94 or Form I-95 (mm/dd/yyyy) or type or print 'D/S' for Duration of Status.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY or 'D/S'. Source: Form I-94. If the beneficiary overstayed, enter the original expiration date. Critical for determining unlawful presence and admissibility bars under INA §212(a)(9).

fields.description: Part 4, Item 46.a.: He or she arrived as a (Class of Admission). The immigration classification under which the beneficiary last entered the U.S.
fields.notes: Examples: B-1, B-2, F-1, H-1B, J-1, K-1, VWT (Visa Waiver), etc. Source: I-94 record or passport admission stamp.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 46.b.: Form I-94 Arrival-Departure Record Number. The 11-digit I-94 number.
fields.notes: Found on the I-94 card (paper) or retrievable online at i94.cbp.dhs.gov. 11-digit number. Leave blank if unknown or if the beneficiary entered without inspection.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 46.c.: Date of Arrival (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the beneficiary most recently arrived in the United States.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Source: I-94, passport stamps, or airline records.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 47: Passport Number. The beneficiary's current passport number.
fields.notes: Source: beneficiary's passport. Alphanumeric. Required for consular processing. If the beneficiary does not have a passport, leave blank and explain in Part 9.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 48: Travel Document Number. The beneficiary's travel document number if different from passport.
fields.notes: For refugees or others with travel documents other than passports. Leave blank if using a passport.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 49: Country of Issuance for Passport or Travel Document.
fields.notes: Full country name of the country that issued the passport or travel document.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 50: Expiration Date for Passport or Travel Document (mm/dd/yyyy).
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Passport must generally be valid for at least 6 months beyond the planned travel date for visa issuance.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.a.: Name of Current Employer (if applicable). The beneficiary's current employer name.
fields.notes: If unemployed, type 'Unemployed'. If self-employed, enter 'Self-employed' or business name. Employment information applies even if employed outside the U.S.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.b.: Street Number and Name of the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Employer's physical address. May be a foreign address.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.c.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.c.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.c.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.c.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.d.: City or Town for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: City where employer is located.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.e.: State for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses. Leave blank for foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.f.: ZIP Code for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.g.: Province for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 52: Date Employment Began (mm/dd/yyyy). Date the beneficiary started current employment.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Leave blank if unemployed.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 53 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Was the beneficiary EVER in immigration proceedings?' Selecting No means the beneficiary has never been in removal, exclusion, deportation, rescission, or judicial proceedings.
fields.notes: If No, skip Items 54-56.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 53 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Was the beneficiary EVER in immigration proceedings?' Selecting Yes means the beneficiary has been in proceedings.
fields.notes: If Yes, must select the type of proceedings in Item 54 and provide location and date in Items 55-56. Prior removal orders may affect eligibility for adjustment or consular processing.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 54 checkbox: 'Removal'. Type of immigration proceedings the beneficiary was in.
fields.notes: Select if the beneficiary was in removal proceedings under INA §240. Multiple types may be selected.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 54 checkbox: 'Exclusion/Deportation'. Type of immigration proceedings.
fields.notes: Select if the beneficiary was in exclusion or deportation proceedings (pre-1996 terminology).

fields.description: Part 4, Item 54 checkbox: 'Rescission'. Type of immigration proceedings.
fields.notes: Rescission proceedings to revoke a prior grant of adjustment of status.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 54 checkbox: 'Other Judicial Proceedings'. Other types of immigration-related judicial proceedings.
fields.notes: Select if the proceedings do not fit the other categories.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 55.a.: City or Town where the immigration proceedings took place.
fields.notes: Location of the immigration court or USCIS office handling the proceedings.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.h.: Postal Code for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 51.i.: Country for the beneficiary's employer address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 55.b.: State where the immigration proceedings took place.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 56: Date (mm/dd/yyyy) of the immigration proceedings.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Date of the proceedings or the final order.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 57.c.: Middle Name. The beneficiary's name in their native written language (if non-Roman letters). Middle name component.
fields.notes: Only required if the beneficiary's native written language does not use Roman letters. Enter name using the native script.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 57.a.: Family Name (Last Name) in the beneficiary's native written language.
fields.notes: Only required if the beneficiary's native language uses non-Roman script (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic). Enter in the native script.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 57.b.: Given Name (First Name) in the beneficiary's native written language.
fields.notes: Only required for non-Roman script languages. Enter in native script.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the beneficiary's foreign address in native script.
fields.notes: Part of the address block for the beneficiary's address in native written language.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the beneficiary's foreign address in native script.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the beneficiary's foreign address in native script.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the beneficiary's address in native script.
fields.notes: Enter unit number in native script if applicable.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.c.: City or Town for the beneficiary's address in native script.
fields.notes: Enter in native written language.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.d.: Province for the beneficiary's address in native script.
fields.notes: Enter in native written language.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.f.: Country for the beneficiary's address in native script.
fields.notes: Enter in native written language.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.e.: Postal Code for the beneficiary's address in native script.
fields.notes: Enter postal code.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 58.a.: Street Number and Name for the beneficiary's address in native written language.
fields.notes: Only required if beneficiary's native language uses non-Roman letters. Enter address in native script.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the last address where the petitioner and beneficiary lived together (spouse petitions).
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions. Part of 'If filing for your spouse, provide the last address at which you physically lived together.'

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the last shared address.
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the last shared address.
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the last shared address.
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.a.: Street Number and Name of the last address at which the petitioner and beneficiary physically lived together. If never lived together, type 'Never lived together'.
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions. Critical for bona fide marriage assessment. If the couple never cohabited, enter 'Never lived together'.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.c.: City or Town of the last shared address.
fields.notes: Only for spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.e.: ZIP Code of the last shared address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.d.: State of the last shared address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 60.a.: Date From (mm/dd/yyyy). Date the petitioner and beneficiary began living together at the shared address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Only for spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 60.b.: Date To (mm/dd/yyyy). Date the petitioner and beneficiary stopped living together at the shared address.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. If still living together, enter 'Present' or current date.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.f.: Province of the last shared address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.h.: Country of the last shared address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 59.g.: Postal Code of the last shared address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 62.a.: City or Town of the U.S. Embassy or Consulate where the beneficiary will apply for an immigrant visa abroad.
fields.notes: Only if the beneficiary will undergo consular processing (not adjustment of status). Choose the embassy/consulate carefully; selecting one outside the beneficiary's country of residence may result in the case being refused.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 62.b.: Province of the U.S. Embassy or Consulate for immigrant visa processing.
fields.notes: Province/region where the embassy or consulate is located.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 62.c.: Country of the U.S. Embassy or Consulate for immigrant visa processing.
fields.notes: Full country name. Typically the beneficiary's country of residence for most straightforward processing.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1 checkbox: 'Yes'. Complete question: 'Have you EVER previously filed a petition for this beneficiary or any other alien?' Selecting Yes means the petitioner has filed prior immigrant petitions.
fields.notes: If Yes, must provide details in Items 2-5 (name, place, date, result). USCIS reviews prior filings for fraud patterns, especially multiple spouse petitions.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 1 checkbox: 'No'. Complete question: 'Have you EVER previously filed a petition for this beneficiary or any other alien?'
fields.notes: If No, skip Items 2-5.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 2.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the person for whom a prior petition was filed.
fields.notes: Required if Item 1 is Yes. Enter the name of the beneficiary of the prior petition.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 2.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the person for whom a prior petition was filed.
fields.notes: Required if Item 1 is Yes.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 2.c.: Middle Name of the person for whom a prior petition was filed.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 5: Result (for example, approved, denied, withdrawn). The outcome of the previously filed petition.
fields.notes: Enter the result as a brief text: 'Approved', 'Denied', 'Withdrawn', 'Pending', etc.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 4: Date Filed (mm/dd/yyyy). The filing date of the previous petition.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 3.a.: City or Town where the prior petition was filed.
fields.notes: City of the USCIS office or service center where the prior petition was filed.

fields.description: Part 5, Item 3.b.: State where the prior petition was filed.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation.
