fields.description: Part 4, Item 61.a.: City or Town of the USCIS office where the beneficiary will apply for adjustment of status.
fields.notes: Only if the beneficiary is in the U.S. and will adjust status. Enter the city of the USCIS field office or service center.

fields.description: Part 4, Item 61.b.: State of the USCIS office where the beneficiary will apply for adjustment of status.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation. Only for adjustment of status cases.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 1, Item 7: Relationship. The petitioner's relationship to the relative for whom a separate petition is also being submitted.
fields.notes: Part of 'If you are also submitting separate petitions for other relatives, provide the names of and your relationship to each relative.' E.g., 'Son', 'Daughter', 'Spouse'.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 1, Item 6.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the other relative for whom a separate petition is being submitted.
fields.notes: Enter if simultaneously filing I-130s for multiple relatives.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 1, Item 6.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the other relative.
fields.notes: Enter if simultaneously filing I-130s for multiple relatives.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 1, Item 6.c.: Middle Name of the other relative.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 3: Petitioner's Daytime Telephone Number. The phone number where the petitioner can be reached during business hours.
fields.notes: Include area code. USCIS may contact the petitioner at this number regarding the petition.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 5: Petitioner's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional. USCIS may use this for electronic notifications.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 4: Petitioner's Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional. Include area code.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 2, Item 8.c.: Middle Name of the second other relative for whom a separate petition is also being submitted.
fields.notes: Leave blank if none. Part 5 continued.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 2, Item 8.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the second other relative.
fields.notes: Enter if simultaneously filing I-130s for multiple relatives.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 2, Item 8.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the second other relative.
fields.notes: Enter if simultaneously filing I-130s for multiple relatives.

fields.description: Part 5, Relative 2, Item 9: Relationship to the second other relative.
fields.notes: E.g., 'Brother', 'Sister', 'Son', 'Daughter'.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 1.a. checkbox: 'I can read and understand English, and I have read and understand every question and instruction on this petition and my answer to every question.' Select if the petitioner can read English.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Item 1.b. Select either 1.a. or 1.b. If the petitioner reads English, select this. If an interpreter is used, select 1.b. instead.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 1.b. checkbox: 'The interpreter named in Part 7. read to me every question and instruction on this petition and my answer to every question in [language], a language in which I am fluent. I understood all of this information as interpreted.' Select if an interpreter assisted the petitioner.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Item 1.a. If selected, must also complete Part 7 (Interpreter information) and enter the language in the adjacent field.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 1.b. language field: The name of the language in which the interpreter read the petition to the petitioner.
fields.notes: Only complete if Item 1.b. is selected. Enter the full language name (e.g., 'Spanish', 'Mandarin', 'Arabic').

fields.description: Part 6, Item 2 checkbox: 'At my request, the preparer named in Part 8., [name], prepared this petition for me based only upon information I provided or authorized.' Select if a preparer assisted.
fields.notes: Select if someone other than the petitioner prepared the form. If selected, must complete Part 8 (Preparer information).

fields.description: Part 6, Item 2: Name of the preparer referenced in the statement 'At my request, the preparer named in Part 8., [name], prepared this petition for me.'
fields.notes: Enter the preparer's full name. Must match the name in Part 8.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.b.: Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the petitioner signs the petition.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Must be the actual date of signing. The petition is certified under penalty of perjury as of this date. Do not pre-date or post-date.

fields.description: Part 6, Item 6.a.: Petitioner's Signature (sign in ink). The petitioner's handwritten signature attesting to the full certification language in Part 6, including: 'I certify, under penalty of perjury, that all of the information in my petition and any document submitted with it were provided or authorized by me, that I reviewed and understand all of the information contained in, and submitted with, my petition, and that all of this information is complete, true, and correct.'
fields.notes: Must be signed in ink (wet signature). Electronic signatures are not accepted for paper filings. The petitioner must personally sign; the preparer or attorney may not sign on behalf of the petitioner. Unsigned petitions will be rejected.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 1.b.: Interpreter's Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Required if an interpreter was used (Part 6, Item 1.b. selected).

fields.description: Part 7, Item 1.a.: Interpreter's Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Required if an interpreter was used.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 2: Interpreter's Business or Organization Name (if any).
fields.notes: Enter the name of the interpreting service or organization if applicable. Leave blank if the interpreter is not affiliated with a business.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.c.: City or Town of the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Enter the interpreter's city.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.a.: Street Number and Name of the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Full street address of the interpreter.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.f.: Postal Code for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.e.: ZIP Code for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.d.: State for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.h.: Country for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 3.g.: Province for the interpreter's mailing address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 7, Interpreter's Certification language field: 'I am fluent in English and [language]'. The name of the language the interpreter used to interpret the petition for the petitioner.
fields.notes: Must match the language specified in Part 6, Item 1.b. Enter the full language name.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 7.b.: Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the interpreter signs the certification.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Should be the same date as or close to the petitioner's signature date.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 7.a.: Interpreter's Signature (sign in ink). The interpreter's handwritten signature attesting to the certification: 'I am fluent in English and [language] which is the same language provided in Part 6., Item Number 1.b., and I have read to this petitioner in the identified language every question and instruction on this petition and his or her answer to every question. The petitioner informed me that he or she understands every instruction, question, and answer on the petition, including the Petitioner's Declaration and Certification, and has verified the accuracy of every answer.'
fields.notes: Must be signed in ink. Required if an interpreter was used.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 1.b.: Preparer's Given Name (First Name).
fields.notes: Required if a preparer other than the petitioner prepared the form.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 2: Preparer's Business or Organization Name (if any).
fields.notes: Enter the law firm or organization name. Leave blank if the preparer is not affiliated with a business.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 1.a.: Preparer's Family Name (Last Name).
fields.notes: Required if a preparer was used.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 4: Interpreter's Daytime Telephone Number.
fields.notes: Include area code. Required for the interpreter.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 6: Interpreter's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 7, Item 5: Interpreter's Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional. Include area code.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.c.: City or Town of the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Enter the preparer's city.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.a.: Street Number and Name of the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Full street address of the preparer.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Apt.' for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Ste. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Ste.' for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Flr.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b.: Unit type checkbox 'Flr.' for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Apt. and Ste.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.b.: Apartment, Suite, or Floor number for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Enter unit number if applicable.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.f.: Postal Code for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.e.: ZIP Code for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: For U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.d.: State for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: 2-letter abbreviation for U.S. addresses.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.h.: Country for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: Full country name.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 3.g.: Province for the preparer's mailing address.
fields.notes: For foreign addresses only.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 5: Preparer's Mobile Telephone Number (if any).
fields.notes: Optional. Despite field name suggesting fax, the form label reads 'Preparer's Mobile Telephone Number (if any)' on the 04/01/24 edition.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 4: Preparer's Daytime Telephone Number.
fields.notes: Include area code. Required for the preparer.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 6: Preparer's Email Address (if any).
fields.notes: Optional.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 7.a. checkbox: 'I am not an attorney or accredited representative but have prepared this petition on behalf of the petitioner and with the petitioner's consent.' Select if preparer is not a legal representative.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Item 7.b. (attorney/accredited representative). If a non-attorney friend or family member prepared the form, select this.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 7.b. checkbox: 'I am an attorney or accredited representative and my representation of the petitioner in this case...' Select if preparer is an attorney or accredited representative.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with Item 7.a. If selected, must also select whether representation extends or does not extend beyond preparation.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 7.b. sub-checkbox: 'extends' - representation extends beyond the preparation of this petition.
fields.notes: If representation extends beyond preparation, a Form G-28 must be submitted. Mutually exclusive with 'does not extend'.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 7.b. sub-checkbox: 'does not extend' - representation does not extend beyond the preparation of this petition.
fields.notes: Mutually exclusive with 'extends'. If selected, no Form G-28 is required.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 8.a.: Preparer's Signature (sign in ink). The preparer's handwritten signature attesting to the certification: 'By my signature, I certify, under penalty of perjury, that I prepared this petition at the request of the petitioner. The petitioner then reviewed this completed petition and informed me that he or she understands all of the information contained in, and submitted with, his or her petition, including the Petitioner's Declaration and Certification, and that all of this information is complete, true, and correct. I completed this petition based only on information that the petitioner provided to me or authorized me to obtain or use.'
fields.notes: Must be signed in ink. The preparer certifies they only used information provided or authorized by the petitioner.

fields.description: Part 8, Item 8.b.: Date of Signature (mm/dd/yyyy). The date the preparer signs.
fields.notes: Format: MM/DD/YYYY. Should be the same date as or close to the petitioner's signature date.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 2: A-Number (if any). The petitioner's Alien Registration Number repeated at the top of the additional information page.
fields.notes: Same A-Number as Part 2, Item 1. Required at top of each Part 9 continuation page for identification.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 3.a.: Page Number. The page number of the form where the additional information belongs (first additional information entry).
fields.notes: Numeric. Reference to which page of the form the additional info pertains to.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 3.b.: Part Number. The part number of the form where the additional information belongs (first entry).
fields.notes: Numeric. E.g., '2' for Part 2, '4' for Part 4.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 3.c.: Item Number. The specific item number being supplemented (first entry).
fields.notes: E.g., '5.a.' for additional other names used.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 3.d.: Additional Information. The additional text or data for the first continuation entry.
fields.notes: Free text. Provide the complete information that did not fit in the referenced field.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 4.a.: Page Number for the second additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric page reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 4.b.: Part Number for the second additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric part reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 4.c.: Item Number for the second additional information entry.
fields.notes: Specific item number being supplemented.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 4.d.: Additional Information for the second continuation entry.
fields.notes: Free text.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 5.a.: Page Number for the third additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric page reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 5.b.: Part Number for the third additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric part reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 5.c.: Item Number for the third additional information entry.
fields.notes: Specific item number being supplemented.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 6.a.: Page Number for the fourth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric page reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 6.b.: Part Number for the fourth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric part reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 6.c.: Item Number for the fourth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Specific item number being supplemented.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 1.a.: Family Name (Last Name) of the petitioner, repeated at the top of the additional information page for identification.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 4.a. Required on each Part 9 continuation page.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 1.b.: Given Name (First Name) of the petitioner, repeated at the top of the additional information page.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 4.b.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 1.c.: Middle Name of the petitioner, repeated at the top of the additional information page.
fields.notes: Must match Part 2, Item 4.c. Leave blank if no middle name.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 6.d.: Additional Information for the fourth continuation entry.
fields.notes: Free text.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 5.d.: Additional Information for the third continuation entry.
fields.notes: Free text.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 7.a.: Page Number for the fifth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric page reference. Despite the field ID suggesting 'Line9a', this maps to the fifth row on the Part 9 continuation page.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 7.b.: Part Number for the fifth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Numeric part reference.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 7.c.: Item Number for the fifth additional information entry.
fields.notes: Specific item number being supplemented.

fields.description: Part 9, Item 7.d.: Additional Information for the fifth continuation entry.
fields.notes: Free text. If more than 5 additional entries are needed, photocopy the Part 9 page and continue.
